info.name: Rodha Course Changes (FE)
info.description:
Student swaps one course for another inside a package they own; admin approves or rejects. Approve gives the new course on Graphy first, then removes the old one; the new course starts fresh. Free — no payment.

Student APIs need header `x-website-category-id`. Errors: 400 {errors:{field:[msg]}}, 404, 409 (blocked / already reviewed), 502 (Graphy failed → request FAILED, approve again to retry).

request.description:
Drives the student 'Change course' screen. `packageId` is optional (omit → all active packages in the category).

- `canRequest=false` → disable the form and show `blockedMessage`.
- `blockedReason`: `DISABLED` | `PENDING_EXISTS` | `MAX_REACHED` | `COOLDOWN`.
- `nextAllowedAt` is set while in cooldown.
- `packages[].courses[]` lists only courses that have at least one option; `options` are the courses the student may switch to.

response.name: 200 can request
200 in cooldown
response.body:

request.description: JSON body. `reason` optional (max 1000). One open request per student. 409 when blocked (pending / max / cooldown / disabled) with `errors.blockedReason`.

request.description:
`remark` optional. Order: give new course on Graphy → remove old course on Graphy → revoke old enrollment + create a fresh one in Rodha.

On a Graphy error the request becomes `FAILED` with `graphyError` and the API returns 502; calling approve again retries only the step that is left. Target courses must be 'available for sale' on Graphy (can be hidden) or Graphy rejects the assign.
